# FlowGuard Plumbing Enterprises

> Coordinated residential and commercial plumbing services in Kano State, Nigeria — featuring reviewed plumbers, transparent itemized quotations after on-site inspection, and live request tracking.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://flowguard.com.ng/): Overview of FlowGuard Plumbing services, 4-step workflow, FAQs, and verified customer reviews.
- [Request a Plumber](https://flowguard.com.ng/request): Submit a service request in Kano and receive a tracking reference number.
- [Track Request](https://flowguard.com.ng/tracking): Check live request status and technician updates using a reference number and phone number.
- [Plumbing Services](https://flowguard.com.ng/services): Pipe installation and repairs, leak detection, drainage clearing, bathroom plumbing, water pumps, and overhead tanks.
- [Kano Service Areas](https://flowguard.com.ng/areas): Active coverage locations across Kano State.
- [Project Gallery](https://flowguard.com.ng/gallery): Published photos from completed plumbing jobs.

## Guides & Support

- [Plumbing Guides (English)](https://flowguard.com.ng/en/blog): Practical plumbing maintenance and troubleshooting guides for Kano homes and businesses.
- [Plumbing Guides (Hausa)](https://flowguard.com.ng/ha/blog): Hausa-language plumbing guides (Jagorar gyaran famfo da famfunan ruwa a Kano).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://flowguard.com.ng/faq): Answers about booking, inspection quotes, coverage areas, and job tracking.
- [Contact Us](https://flowguard.com.ng/contact): Direct phone, WhatsApp, and enquiry form for FlowGuard Plumbing Enterprises.
